English: I must say, lordship can be quite a curse!
Chinese: 我得说，当领主有时候真是种诅咒！

English: I own the deed to the [[mines]] in the Southwest. Between you and I, it's worth a fortune.##But a few months ago it simply ceased to produce! As if out of thin air!
Chinese: 我握着西南边[[矿区]]的地契。跟你说句体己话，那可是笔天大的财富。##可几个月前，它突然就绝产了！凭空！

English: I'm so sorry to hear that.
Chinese: 听到这个我很难过。

English: I've been to those mines recently.
Chinese: 我最近去过那些矿坑。

English: I've no interest in your bourgeois concerns.
Chinese: 我对你们有产阶级的烦恼没兴趣。

English: Ah, you're familiar, then? Splendid!
Chinese: 哦，那你就熟悉那儿了？好极了！

English: Now, I sent a [[couple servants]] down to the mines see what the matter is.##As you'd expect, they both split on me; Took their pay and disappeared!
Chinese: 于是，我派了[[几个仆人]]下去看看出了什么事。##不出你所料，他俩把工钱一分就卷款跑了！

English: Every day that my [[mines]] aren't operating, I'm losing gold!##What a mess!
Chinese: 我的[[矿区]]每停工一天，我就在亏金子！##简直乱套！

English: Tell me more about the [[mines]].
Chinese: 再跟我讲讲那些[[矿区]]。

English: Tell me about yourself.
Chinese: 说说你自己吧。

English: Ah, forgive me. I am [[Romulous Chairon VII]], lord and heir to the [[Southwestern Tract]].##The lands I own are rich in resources. The finest in the world. I employ merchants who sell them for me. Even the crown buys my ores.
Chinese: 哦，失礼了。我是[[罗慕路斯·凯隆七世]]，[[西南领地]]的领主与继承人。##我名下的土地资源丰饶，举世无双。我雇商人替我售卖。连王室都买我的矿。

English: I've been to the mines; here's what I've seen.
Chinese: 我去过矿坑；我看到的情形是这样的。

English: I must be off.
Chinese: 我得走了。

English: My mines are to the Southwest.##The ores are a valuable export. Fine orestones fetch a devilish price in the [[Clockwork Kingdom]].
Chinese: 我的矿在西南边。##矿石是值钱的出口货。精矿石在[[发条王国]]能卖出吓死人的价钱。

English: I've likely owned my mines since before you were born! Though I don't involve myself much in its going-ons. There are people beneath me who were handling those trivialities on-site.##Breather, perhaps you could look into it for me?
Chinese: 我拥有这些矿，八成比你出生都早！不过我不太管那些日常琐事，底下有人替我打理。##呼吸者，或许你能替我去查查？

English: Ah, would you be so kind? It would mean the world to me.
Chinese: 哦，你愿意帮这个忙？这对我意义重大。

English: I'd be happy to help.
Chinese: 我很乐意帮忙。

English: @@For a fee, of course!
Chinese: @@当然，得收报酬！

English: &&<<He scowls>>##You'll be paid on delivery.
Chinese: &&<<他皱起眉头>>##事成之后再付钱。

English: %%<<He scowls>>##I'm afraid 20 gold is all I'll offer, I'm rather tight at the moment...
Chinese: %%<<他皱起眉头>>##恐怕我只能出20金币，我手头挺紧的……

English: Marvelous! I had a feeling about you as soon as we spoke.
Chinese: 太好了！一开始跟你说话我就有预感。

English: The mines are on the Southwestern edge of the region.##The elevator is likely out of operation, but you can make your way down by a series of bridges.
Chinese: 矿在区域的西南边。##升降梯八成罢工了，不过你可以顺着一条条的桥走下去。

English: Return when you've solved this fiasco, and I'll produce a suitable reward. You have my word, breather!
Chinese: 等你把这场烂摊子收拾好了再来，我会备好一份像样的报酬。我向你保证，呼吸者！

English: <<After hearing half of your story, he interrupts you.>>##You're just complicating things, believing all their commotion about crystals. The truth is simple: those greedy miners have stolen my mines!
Chinese: <<听了你一半的话，他打断了你。>>##你就是把事情搞复杂了，还信他们那套关于水晶的鬼话。真相很简单：那些贪心的矿工偷了我的矿！

English: Breather! Go back and tell them at once! These mines belong to me!##You'll be rewarded handsomely, on my honor!
Chinese: 呼吸者！回去立刻告诉他们！这些矿是我的！##你会得到丰厚的报酬，我以名誉担保！

English: My friend, I've been waiting for your return! I've been informed of your success already.##A promise is a promise; here is your reward.
Chinese: 我的朋友，我一直在等你回来！你的成功我已经听说了。##一诺千金；这是你的报酬。

English: So you're the one who liberated my mines! An honor to meet you.##I've prepared a reward for you.
Chinese: 原来你就是解放我矿区的功臣！有幸相见。##我为你备好了一份报酬。

English: Thank you, my lord.
Chinese: 谢谢您，大人。

English: @@This amount is hardly adequate.
Chinese: @@这点钱可远远不够。

English: &&Hmph. I've been quite generous as it is.##A bit of tact and dignity would go a long way!
Chinese: &&哼。我已经相当大方了。##懂点分寸、要点体面，对你有好处！

English: %%A negotiator, are you, breather? Ha, very well! I admire an enterprising youngster.##Take this. It's an excellent year.
Chinese: %%还挺会谈价的，是吧呼吸者？哈，好吧！我欣赏有进取心的年轻人。##拿着。这可是个好年头。

English: My dear friend! So good to see you.##Perhaps you've heard? my mines will resume operation soon. I've paid a party of young men to sort it out. They say it will be any day now.
Chinese: 我亲爱的朋友！见到你真高兴。##也许你听说了？我的矿很快就要复工了。我雇了一伙年轻人去解决问题。他们说随时都能恢复。

English: Ore is fetching an exorbitant rate in the [[Clockwork Kingdom.]] I'll make my fortune back in no time.
Chinese: 矿石在[[发条王国]]卖出了天价。我很快就能把本钱赚回来。

English: What will become of the crystal cultists?
Chinese: 那些水晶教徒会怎么样？

English: The mutineers, you mean? Any stragglers will be quartered.
Chinese: 你是说那些叛党？凡是漏网的都会被分尸处死。

English: I'm preparing a troup of mercenaries to that very end.##They should be ready within the week.
Chinese: 我正在为此组建一支佣兵队。##一周之内就能就绪。

English: The mines belong to [[us]] now.
Chinese: 矿现在归[[我们]]了。

English: <<He looks equally shocked and incredulous>>##What the hell are you talking about, fleshsack!? I've owned the deed to that land since before your great grandfather was born!
Chinese: <<他一脸震惊，又满是不信>>##你到底在放什么屁，血肉袋子！？那块地的地契在你曾祖父出生前就归我了！

English: You there! Spill it! What do you know about my mines?##I've owned the deed to that land since before your great grandfather was born!
Chinese: 你！从实招来！关于我的矿你都知道些什么？##那块地的地契在你曾祖父出生前就归我了！

English: I'm sorry.
Chinese: 对不起。

English: <<He rolls his eyes at this.>>##You're ((sorry))!? I don't even care about you!
Chinese: <<他对此翻了个白眼。>>##你((对不起))！？我根本就不在乎你！

English: Forget about the mines.
Chinese: 别想那矿了。

English: You must be joking! My mines make up the better part of my fortune! Would you have me wither and die, a ragged vagrant adrift in the wilderness?
Chinese: 你开玩笑吧！我的矿是我家产的大头！你是想让我枯萎而死，做个衣衫褴褛的流浪汉漂泊荒野吗？

English: <<[Kill]>> Behold, the [[power]] of our goddess!
Chinese: <<[杀死]>>看吧，我们女神的[[力量]]！

English: <<At this invocation, the nobleman's body crystallizes rapidly. He can scarcely let out a scream before his lungs turn solid.>>
Chinese: <<随着这一声召唤，贵族的身体迅速水晶化。他还没来得及喊出声，肺就已变成固体。>>

English: I have nothing more to say to you
Chinese: 我对你无话可说

English: <<The resident scratches at the painful crystalline growth which protrudes from his left eye...>>
Chinese: <<居民抓挠着从左眼凸出的、疼痛的水晶增生……>>

English: I just want this nightmare to end.
Chinese: 我只想让这场噩梦结束。

English: What happened?
Chinese: 发生了什么？

English: Aaargh! I can feel it in my face. [[She's]] inside me, crawling out!
Chinese: 啊啊啊！我能感觉到它在我脸上。[[她]]在我体内，正往外爬！

English: There's a woman... inside you?
Chinese: 有个女人……在你身体里？

English: Pieces of many people together. She's filling my face up with sharp corners.
Chinese: 许多人的碎片拼在一起。她用尖角填满我的脸。

English: Stay out of the [[mines]].##She wants to grow...
Chinese: 别进[[矿坑]]。##她想生长……

English: You're talking about the crystals in the mines.
Chinese: 你说的是矿里的水晶。

English: Do you know where those crystals come from? They're all crying out in pain...
Chinese: 你知道那些水晶从哪儿来吗？它们全都在痛苦地哭喊……

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: <<This question distresses him greatly, and he begins to whimper.>>##Who was I? Perhaps... no that can't be right...
Chinese: <<这个问题让他痛苦不已，他开始呜咽。>>##我从前是谁？也许……不，不对……

English: I think I was a foreman... or a miner maybe? Or was I a soldier?##I remember being a young boy when the Crusaders came and... No. I must have been his mother.... But that can't have been me either...
Chinese: 我记得我是个工头……或者矿工？还是士兵？##我记得十字军来的时候我还是个小男孩……不对。我一定是他的母亲……可那也不该是我……

English: Some of these memories aren't mine...
Chinese: 这些记忆有些不是我的……

English: I'll see what I can do...
Chinese: 我看看能做点什么……

English: I think I'm really dying this time. I'm so afraid.
Chinese: 我觉得这次我真的要死了。我好害怕。

English: <<he weeps with gratitude. The crystals in his face have receded>> Thank you so much... I can't believe it's ending.
Chinese: <<他感激地流下眼泪。他脸上的水晶已经消退>>太谢谢你了……真不敢相信噩梦要结束了。

English: Please, take this! Though I know it's not much...
Chinese: 请收下这个！虽然我知道不多……

English: Take care.
Chinese: 保重。

English: I understand now. What it is to be, without the lines and boundaries of self.
Chinese: 我现在明白了。没有自我的线条与边界，去存在是什么滋味。

English: It makes no difference whose pain this was; it belongs to everyone.
Chinese: 这痛苦曾属于谁已无关紧要；它属于所有人。

English: This is a sacred place. You shouldn't be here. My siblings will kill you.
Chinese: 这是神圣之地。你不该来。我的兄弟姐妹会杀了你。

English: You'd better leave. [[She]] knows what you are, and what you intend to do here.
Chinese: 你最好离开。[[她]]知道你是什么，也知道你打算在这儿做什么。

English: What do you suspect I'll do?
Chinese: 你怀疑我要做什么？

English: We do not suspect. We simply know.##Our mistress reveals the truth with absolute perfection.
Chinese: 我们不怀疑。我们只是知道。##我们的女主人以绝对完美揭示真相。

English: What's happened to these [[mines]]?
Chinese: 这些[[矿坑]]发生了什么？

English: Mines? Have you been blinded by a dark curse? These are not mines. They are more akin to the inside of a fertile egg.
Chinese: 矿坑？你是被黑暗诅咒迷了眼吗？这些不是矿坑。它们更像一颗饱满的卵的内部。

English: Who is your [[mistress]]?
Chinese: 你们的[[女主人]]是谁？

English: My mistress is the one who will save this accursed region.
Chinese: 我的女主人是将拯救这片受诅咒之地的人。

English: She will heal us of the weight we've carried so long.
Chinese: 她将治愈我们背负已久的重担。

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: Who am ... I?##... I'm afraid I don't understand your line of reasoning.
Chinese: 我是……谁？##……恐怕我不明白你的思路。

English: I must go.
Chinese: 我得走了。

English: <<They wail with overwhelming grief. There is no fight left in them.>>
Chinese: <<他们发出撕心裂肺的恸哭。他们再无战意。>>

English: You've become part of us! Truly Her power is miraculous.##Oh celebration! Oh jouissance!
Chinese: 你已成为我们的一部分！她的力量真是奇迹。##哦，欢庆！哦，极乐！

English: Will you go beyond this egg? Venture from Her womb so as to spread Her truth?##Please, take this with you.
Chinese: 你要走出这颗卵吗？离开她的子宫，去传播她的真理？##请带上这个。

English: Astounding. Everything is being made clear now. How marvelous. I can see it.
Chinese: 不可思议。一切正在变得清晰。多么美妙。我看得见了。

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: I was once a child. Many children. We committed evils beyond redemption. But these are all Her memories now.
Chinese: 我曾是个孩子。许多孩子。我们犯下无法救赎的恶。但如今这些都是她的记忆了。

English: A thousand perspectives, refracted through her.##We remember being devoured; remember dying. But we also remember devouring.
Chinese: 千种视角，经她折射。##我们记得被吞食；记得死亡。但我们也记得吞食。

English: That's what's really inside these crystals, you know. Old wounds.
Chinese: 你知道吗，这些水晶里面装的其实是旧伤。

English: But She is merciful, showing the truth even to a wretch like me.
Chinese: 但她是仁慈的，连我这个可怜虫也能得见真相。

English: What do you see?
Chinese: 你看见了什么？

English: A body amalgamate. Abstract geometry and structure.##Perfect in its form, steeped in a sorrow beyond compare.
Chinese: 一个身体的聚合体。抽象的几何与结构。##形态完美，浸透着无与伦比的悲伤。

English: The true form of the divine; the great continuum of all that is.
Chinese: 神圣的真形；万有的宏大连续体。

English: Is [[She]] a god?
Chinese: [[她]]是神吗？

English: One day She will be. Soon, perhaps.
Chinese: 总有一天她会是的。也许很快。

English: What does [[She]] want?
Chinese: [[她]]想要什么？

English: <<She pauses, as if listening for the answer.>>##It... isn't so simple. There's so many of her.
Chinese: <<她停下，仿佛在聆听答案。>>##这……没那么简单。她太多了。

English: She wants to save us from our cruel fate.##We endless are all caught in this great misery; toiling away in a place without gods. Eternal mourning on an island of graves.
Chinese: 她想把我们从残酷的命运中解救出来。##我们无尽者都困在这巨大的苦难里；在没有神明的地方劳作至死。在坟墓之岛上永恒哀悼。

English: The tragedy of the Crusades hangs over this island like a grand condemnation.
Chinese: 十字军的悲剧如同一纸宏大判决，笼罩着这座岛。

English: But... there's something else. It's difficult to explain.
Chinese: 但是……还有别的。很难解释。

English: She wants to heal too... More than that; she wants to escape.##There's rage there, almost like a cornered animal, or a man in a cage.
Chinese: 她也想治愈……不止如此；她想逃出去。##那里有愤怒，像走投无路的野兽，又像笼中人。

English: <<She stands in awe of the visions before her.>>
Chinese: <<她敬畏地望着眼前的幻象。>>

English: I cannot see it anymore. The tapestry of creation is concealed again.
Chinese: 我看不见了。创世的锦缎重新被遮住。

English: Our divine light; where has She gone?##These caverns are so dark without her...
Chinese: 我们神圣的光；她去哪儿了？##没有她，这些洞穴如此黑暗……

English: <<He awakens from a state of meditative prayer.>>
Chinese: <<他从冥想祈祷中醒来。>>

English: May ye be blessed.
Chinese: 愿你得福。

English: @@I'm here to show my devotion.
Chinese: @@我是来表示虔敬的。

English: &&<<He looks at you and closes his eyes. After a long pause he wordlessly shakes his head in refusal.>>
Chinese: &&<<他看着你，闭上眼睛。长久的停顿后，他一言不发地摇头拒绝。>>

English: %%<<He looks at you and closes his eyes. After a long pause he nods his head in acceptance.>>##<<He silently unlocks the gate to the [[hymnal chamber]]>>
Chinese: %%<<他看着你，闭上眼睛。长久的停顿后，他点头应允。>>##<<他默默打开了通往[[圣咏室]]的门>>

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: I am a midwife of our new god.
Chinese: 我是我们新神的接生者。

English: [[The sculptor]] has entrusted me guardian of the [[hymnal chamber]].
Chinese: [[圣雕师]]托我守卫[[圣咏室]]。

English: Tell me of the [[hymnal chamber]].
Chinese: 跟我说说[[圣咏室]]。

English: The hymnal chamber lies through this gate. It is a place of sacred ritual.
Chinese: 圣咏室就在这道门后。那是举行神圣仪式的地方。

English: By our faith, Her dream becomes possible.##And by Her dream, all dreams.
Chinese: 凭我们的信仰，她的梦成为可能。##凭她的梦，一切梦皆成。

English: I'm here to show my devotion.
Chinese: 我是来表示虔敬的。

English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: You've ruined everything, you pathetic vermin. Now nothing can help us...
Chinese: 你毁掉了一切，你这可怜的害虫。如今没有什么能救我们了……

English: May great misfortune befall you.
Chinese: 愿大祸降临于你。

English: @@You're defeated. Let me through.
Chinese: @@你败了。让我过去。

English: %%...I suppose it makes no difference to me either way.##<<He opens the gate, a look of defeat on his face.>>
Chinese: %%……我想这对我怎样都无所谓了。##<<他打开大门，一脸败象。>>

English: &&<<He spits in your face.>>
Chinese: &&<<他朝你脸上啐了一口。>>

English: Welcome, kindred. May ye be blessed.
Chinese: 欢迎，同类。愿你得福。

English: Of course, kindred.##<<He opens the way for you.>>
Chinese: 当然可以，同类。##<<他为你让开了路。>>

English: Thank you for freeing me! I thought I was done for!
Chinese: 谢谢你放我出来！我以为这下完了！

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: I am Inquisitor MCCXVII of the Apostatic Union. At your service.
Chinese: 我是叛教联盟的 MCCXVII 号审判官。愿效犬马之劳。

English: What's an Inquisitor doing in these mines?
Chinese: 审判官在这些矿坑里做什么？

English: There were four of us, sent to investigate a possible class-C god entity.
Chinese: 我们一共四人，奉命调查一个疑似 C 级神体。

English: But I was separated from the rest of the tribunal and taken prisoner.
Chinese: 可我跟审判团其他人走散，被俘了。

English: I'm not sure what became of my comrades...
Chinese: 我不知道我的同伴们怎么样了……

English: We weren't able to nullify the god entity. Our quest was a resounding failure...
Chinese: 我们没能压制那个神体。我们的任务一败涂地……

English: I can help.
Chinese: 我可以帮忙。

English: Sorry...
Chinese: 抱歉……

English: Yes, perfect! [[take this!]]##It's a [[terminus prism]]. It can kill a god-entity like this one.
Chinese: 太好了！[[拿着这个！]]##这是[[终末棱镜]]。它能杀死像这样的神体。

English: You can set this whole mess right!
Chinese: 你能收拾好这烂摊子！

English: @@I need any supplies you've stashed.
Chinese: @@把你藏的物资都给我。

English: %%Of course! I keep these defense potions hidden in case of emergencies.
Chinese: %%当然！我藏了这些防御药水，以备不时之需。

English: &&I...I'm afraid they took everything when I was captured.##And besides, I still need to get myself out of here...
Chinese: &&我……恐怕我被俘时他们把东西全搜走了。##再说，我还得想办法逃出去呢……

English: This [[terminus prism]]... it can kill a god?
Chinese: 这[[终末棱镜]]……能杀死神？

English: Only fledgling god entities, like this one, which are undergoing [[apotheosis]].##The [[prism]] has no effect on an older god entity.
Chinese: 只能杀死像这样正在[[封神]]中的初生神体。##[[棱镜]]对更古老的神体没有作用。

English: Before we were separated, my tribunal determined that this [[crystal entity]] is currently in an advanced stage of apotheosis.
Chinese: 在我们走散之前，审判团判定这个[[水晶神体]]目前处于封神的后期阶段。

English: At this stage, a god entity is still malleable to the imaginations of its followers.##That's how the [[prism]] kills the entity.
Chinese: 在这个阶段，神体仍会受信徒的想象塑形。##[[棱镜]]就是这样杀死神体的。

English: What will you do now?
Chinese: 你现在打算怎么办？

English: I'll make for the surface once I have a good opportunity.##I'm in no state to fight, so I'll have to slip through somehow...
Chinese: 一有机会我就往地表走。##我现在这状态打不了，只能设法悄悄溜出去……

English: I am the [[sculptor]], Lucia.##The [[crystal goddess]] told me y'ed come.
Chinese: 我是[[圣雕师]]露西亚。##[[水晶女神]]告诉俺，你会来。

English: So. What's yer intention?
Chinese: 说吧。你来想干什么？

English: You sculpted this?
Chinese: 这是你雕的？

English: Aye, I was th' first to hear it, through the rock walls.##Biggest pocket of pure crystal any of us'd ever seen.
Chinese: 是啊，俺是头一个隔着岩壁听见她的。##俺们谁都没见过那么大的一窝纯水晶。

English: I knew the shape She needed t' take. It felt like I was born with it in me. So I started carving in secret...
Chinese: 俺知道她该长成什么形状。那感觉就像俺生下来就带着它。所以俺就偷偷开始雕……

English: I'm here to swear my loyalty to the [[Crystal Goddess.]]
Chinese: 我是来向[[水晶女神]]宣誓效忠的。

English: <<She grins.>>##Glad t' hear it.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴一笑。>>##听你这么说俺高兴。

English: T' complete your bond, go before [[Her]] and pledge yer devotion.##<<Lucia teaches you a series of>> [[ritual handsigns]] <<needed to complete the pact.>>
Chinese: 要缔结你们的契约，就去[[她]]面前起誓献上虔敬。##<<露西亚教你一套>>[[仪式手印]]<<，完成契约必不可少。>>

English: When you are ready, go before the [[Crystal Goddess]] and pledge your loyalty.
Chinese: 等你准备好，就去[[水晶女神]]面前宣誓效忠。

English: You have to end this madness!
Chinese: 你得结束这场疯狂！

English: Hell are ye talkin' about, breather? "Madness"!? Ye must be joking!
Chinese: 你到底在说什么鬼话，呼吸者？"疯狂"！？你肯定在开玩笑！

English: Centuries in this godless land, toiling in th' mines with no way out. Eating fake flesh, like some kind of livestock. That's madness.##Th' bloody [[Crusades]]! THAT was madness!
Chinese: 在这片没有神的土地上熬几个世纪，在矿井里做牛做马没个出路。吃着假血肉，跟牲口一样。那才叫疯狂。##那该死的[[十字军]]！那才是疯狂！

English: As a young girl I was trained t' be a sculptor. Before th' crusades. I became a miner to survive.##Th' dreams that died back then never disappeared. I've carried that rotten weight.
Chinese: 俺小时候学的是雕石像。十字军之前的事了。为了活命，俺才当了矿工。##当年死掉的那些梦从来没有消失。那腐烂的重量俺一直背着。

English: Every endless knows th' experience. That's why [[She]] came t' us.##Ye'd wither to call it madness if you knew.
Chinese: 每个无尽者都尝过那种滋味。所以[[她]]才来找俺们。##你要是知道内情，就绝不会说那是疯狂。

English: Forgive me. I want to follow the [[Crystal Goddess.]]
Chinese: 原谅我。我想追随[[水晶女神]]。

English: <<Lucia looks you in the eyes, gauging your sincerity.>>
Chinese: <<露西亚直视你的眼睛，掂量你的诚意。>>

English: Aye, Very well.
Chinese: 好吧，就这么定了。

English: <<Lucia watches you cautiously.>>
Chinese: <<露西亚警惕地注视着你。>>

English: [[No!]] How could ye!?##Bloody bastard! [[I'll butcher you!]]
Chinese: [[不！]]你怎么能！？##该死的杂种！[[俺要把你剁了！]]

English: You don't stand a chance against me.
Chinese: 你根本打不过我。

English: <<Lucia shrieks with rage. Her voice reverberates with the magic imbued in her body.>>##Kill me then! It dun matter!
Chinese: <<露西亚愤怒地尖叫。她的声音里回荡着浸在体内的魔法。>>##那就杀了俺！无所谓了！

English: I had no choice. I'm trying to save you.
Chinese: 我别无选择。我是想救你。

English: Save me!? I'll kill you!!
Chinese: 救我！？我要杀了你！！

English: Forgive me! It was an accident.
Chinese: 原谅我！那是个意外。

English: <<Lucia spits in your direction.>>##Lying worm!
Chinese: <<露西亚朝你的方向啐了一口。>>##撒谎的虫豸！

English: Welcome, kindred.
Chinese: 欢迎，同类。

English: Y' had a change of heart? Forgive me fr' my harsh words. We're kindred now.
Chinese: 你回心转意了？原谅俺之前说话冲。咱们现在是同类了。

English: <<You stand beneath an intricate crystal statue. It exudes an unmistakable psychic weight.>>
Chinese: <<你站在一尊精巧的水晶雕像之下。它散发着一种不容错认的精神重压。>>

English: <<Smash the statue...>>
Chinese: <<砸碎雕像……>>

English: <<Your weapons and magic would hardly scratch the statue's solid crystal.>>##<<You wonder if there may be a way besides brute force, and if you should explore the mines more.>>
Chinese: <<你的武器和魔法几乎伤不了雕像的坚实水晶分毫。>>##<<你琢磨着除了蛮力是否还有别的办法，也许该把矿坑探得更深些。>>

English: <<Use the>> [[terminus prism]] <<to purge the statue...>>
<<You hold the >>[[terminus prism]]<< in your hand, but before raising it, you wonder:>>##<<Are you sure this is the choice you want to make? The goddess >>[[cannot be rebuilt.]]
Chinese: <<你握着>>[[终末棱镜]]<<，但在举起它之前，你心想：>>##<<你确定要做出这个选择吗？女神>>[[无法被重建。]]

English: <<Raise the prism and>> [[kill the goddess...]]
Chinese: <<举起棱镜，>>[[杀死女神……]]

English: <<The room seems to go totally silent. Then, a piercing noise resonates through the crystals.>>##<<The statue begins to crumble.>>
Chinese: <<整个房间仿佛陷入死寂。随后，一声刺耳的鸣响在水晶间共鸣。>>##<<雕像开始崩解。>>

English: <<Reconsider your options...>>
Chinese: <<重新考虑你的选择……>>

English: <<Admire the statue...>>
Chinese: <<欣赏雕像……>>

English: <<Remarkably crafted, the positioning of each arm and leg clearly carries deep meaning to the artist.>>
Chinese: <<工艺精湛，每一只手脚的摆放对雕者而言显然都蕴含深意。>>

English: <<The identical lower face peers out from between Her legs as if being born. The word "self-begotten" floats through your mind.>>
Chinese: <<一张一模一样的下脸从她双腿之间探出，仿佛正在降生。"自孕而生"这个词飘过你的脑海。>>

English: <<The longer you look, the more admiration you feel. Not just for the artist and her achievement, but for the Crystal Goddess herself and all the depths that she carries.>>
Chinese: <<你看得越久，敬意越深。不只是为雕师和她的成就，更是为水晶女神本人，以及她承载的所有深邃。>>

English: <<Pledge your loyalty to the crystal goddess...>>
Chinese: <<向水晶女神宣誓效忠……>>

English: <<Before performing the>> [[ritual]] <<which Lucia taught you, you wonder:>>##<<Are you sure this is the choice you want to make?>>##<<A pact such as this>> [[cannot be broken.]]
Chinese: <<在施展露西亚教你的>>[[仪式]]<<之前，你心想：>>##<<你确定要做出这个选择吗？>>##<<这样的契约>>[[无法解除。]]

English: <<Perform the [[ritual handsigns]] and devote yourself to the [[crystal goddess...]]
Chinese: <<施行[[仪式手印]]，将你自己献给[[水晶女神……]]

English: <<Visions cross through your mind of geometric threads, converging at the statue's heart.##Immaculate webs extend in all directions, weaving through the veins of the surrounding rock.>>
Chinese: <<幻象掠过脑海：几何的丝线，在雕像的心脏处汇聚。##无瑕的蛛网向四面八方延展，织入四周岩层的脉络。>>

English: <<You see the cosmic totality unified through her.>>
Chinese: <<你看见宇宙的全体经由她归于一体。>>

English: <<The goddess sees you too, with that caressing gaze of hers.##She sees all things.>>
Chinese: <<女神也看见了你，用她那爱抚般的凝视。##她看见万物。>>

English: My beautiful child.##You will retain yourself, because you have another purpose. I have set an even finer role in the tapestry for you.
Chinese: 我美丽的孩子。##你会保有自己的存在，因为你另有使命。我在锦缎上为你安排了一个更精妙的位置。

English: I will guide you now. Take this with you##<<You feel something move inside your bag...>>
Chinese: 从今往后我会指引你。带上这个##<<你感觉背包里有什么东西动了……>>

English: <<Looking inside, you find a small parcel, wrapped neatly in flower petals.>>
Chinese: <<往里一看，你发现一个小包裹，用花瓣整整齐齐地包着。>>

English: <<Looking inside, you discover that the >>[[terminus prism]]<< - which the imprisoned inquisitor gave you - has been smashed.##In the middle of the pieces lies a small parcel, wrapped neatly in flower petals.>>
Chinese: <<往里一看，你发现被囚审判官给你的>>[[终末棱镜]]<<已经碎了。##碎片中间躺着一个小包裹，用花瓣整整齐齐地包着。>>

English: Thank you.
Chinese: 谢谢。

English: <<Leave...>>
<<You stand beneath your sworn guardian, the >>[[crystal goddess.]]<< She guides your fate now.>>
Chinese: <<你站在你宣誓效忠的守护者>>[[水晶女神]]<<之下。如今她指引着你的命运。>>
